text: Given a valid X-Axcient-Api-Key header, when axcient_list_clients is called, then it returns the clients visible to that key's Axcient organization (id, name, active)
steps: Configure a real Axcient partner API key as X-Axcient-Api-Key
Call tools/call axcient_list_clients with no filters
expect: HTTP 200; response contains a clients[] array with at least the org's known clients, each with id/name/active; has_more reflects whether more than the default limit exist
evidence: needs a real vendor account (no test API key available at design time); not run

text: Given no X-Axcient-Api-Key header, when any axcient_* tool is called, then the service returns HTTP 401 naming the missing header
Given the vendor API returns 401 for the configured key, when a tool calls it, then the tool result is {"error":{"code":"unauthorized",...}} rather than a raised exception
Given a device_id that does not exist, when axcient_get_device is called, then the vendor's 404 is surfaced as {"error":{"code":"not_found",...}}
Given a device/appliance/vault exists, when its axcient_get_* tool is called, then the response includes the vendor's own health signal (current_health_status / tunnel_status / active)
steps: Configure a real Axcient partner API key
Call axcient_get_device for a known device_id
Call axcient_get_appliance and axcient_get_vault for known ids
Inspect each response for the health field
expect: Each response includes current_health_status (device), tunnel_status (appliance/vault) without a second call
evidence: needs a real vendor account; not run

text: Given a list endpoint has more results than the page size, when the matching axcient_list_* tool is called, then the result is capped at limit (default <=50, hard max <=200) and has_more is set correctly
steps: Either use a real org with >50 clients, or feed the mocked vendor client a paged fixture of 60 records
Inspect the returned count and has_more
expect: Exactly <=50 items returned, has_more=true; a second call with cursor returns the remainder
evidence: needs a real vendor account with >50 clients, or a mocked paged fixture not yet built; not run

text: Given a vault's connectivity threshold is changed via axcient_set_vault_connectivity_threshold, when axcient_get_vault_connectivity_threshold is called afterward, then it reflects the new value
steps: Configure a real Axcient partner API key with write access to a test vault
Call axcient_get_vault_connectivity_threshold to record the current value
Call axcient_set_vault_connectivity_threshold with a different value
expect: Second get call returns the value just set, not the original one
evidence: needs a real vendor account with a non-production test vault; not run (write-path, must not be run against a live production vault without authorization)

text: Given tenant A's key and tenant B's key belong to two different Axcient organizations, when tenant A calls an axcient_get_* tool with an id belonging to tenant B's organization, then no data belonging to organization B is returned to tenant A (cross-tenant / BOLA anchor)
steps: Obtain two real Axcient partner API keys from two different organizations
Note a client_id/device_id/vault_id that exists under organization B
Call the matching axcient_get_* tool using organization A's key with that id
expect: Tool returns {"error":{"code":"not_found"|"unauthorized",...}}; no fields from organization B's resource appear in the response
evidence: needs two real vendor accounts in different Axcient organizations; not run

text: Given the vendor API returns 429 with Retry-After, when a tool call hits it, then the service retries with backoff and only returns {"error":{"code":"rate_limited",...}} after retries are exhausted

Given two concurrent requests carry different X-Axcient-Api-Key values, when both are in flight at the same time, then neither request's credential or response data is observable by the other (contextvars isolation)
